findings.highlight: I have no way to kill him
findings.evidenceJa: ヤツを倒す術がない
findings.governingReading: Shirou says he has no means to defeat Zouken.
findings.explanation: The English again narrows defeat into killing.

findings.highlight: he’s a monster one can’t talk with
findings.evidenceJa: 話し合いなど通じない妖怪
findings.governingReading: Zouken is a monster with whom negotiation or reasoned discussion will not work.
findings.explanation: The English makes Zouken conversationally inaccessible rather than impervious to negotiation.

findings.evidenceJa: 千に届く名剣・魔剣
findings.governingReading: Archer’s arm records nearly a thousand famous swords and magical or demonic swords.
findings.explanation: The English removes both classes and leaves only generic swords.

findings.highlight: I lie down on the tatami
findings.evidenceJa: 重い体を畳に預ける
findings.governingReading: Shirou entrusts his heavy body to the tatami.
findings.explanation: The English omits the bodily heaviness marking his condition.

findings.evidenceJa: 少し疲れた
findings.governingReading: Shirou says he is a little tired.
findings.explanation: The English removes the minimizing qualification that helps conceal the seriousness of his condition.

findings.highlight: it seems I went and treated Sakura
findings.evidenceJa: 桜の見舞いをしたらしい
findings.governingReading: The objects suggest that Shirou visited or checked on Sakura after noon.
findings.explanation: The English invents medical treatment.

findings.highlight: They must be in the guest rooms
findings.evidenceJa: 桜は客間、イリヤは和室だろう
findings.governingReading: Shirou locates Sakura in the guest room and Illya in the Japanese-style room.
findings.explanation: The English collapses two distinct rooms into plural guest rooms.

findings.evidenceJa: トントントン、と小気味いい包丁の音
findings.governingReading: Rin’s knife makes a crisp, pleasant rhythmic chopping sound.
findings.explanation: The English omits the rhythm and the sound’s light, competent quality.

findings.highlight: she’s cutting lots of green peppers
findings.evidenceJa: 大量のピーマンを千切りにする
findings.governingReading: Rin juliennes a large quantity of green peppers.
findings.explanation: The English removes the specific cutting technique.

findings.evidenceJa: 牛肉を豪快にブツ切りにする
findings.governingReading: Rin boldly or roughly chops the beef into chunks.
findings.explanation: The English changes coarse chunking into the finer, orderly action of dicing.

findings.evidenceJa: どっちなんだ一体
findings.governingReading: Shirou reacts to the contradictory vegetable-dish and meat-dish signals with “Which is it?”
findings.explanation: The English turns the comic contradiction into a generic question about the dish.

findings.evidenceJa: ぼやきながら風呂場に向かう
findings.governingReading: Shirou heads toward the bathroom while grumbling.
findings.explanation: The English removes his comic delivery.

findings.evidenceJa: ひとりでに電灯が消えた
findings.governingReading: The electric lights go out on their own.
findings.explanation: The English omits the spontaneous quality that makes the blackout suspicious.

findings.evidenceJa: 明かり、スイッチ入れてもつかないし
findings.governingReading: The lights do not come on even when the switches are turned on.
findings.explanation: The English says the switches themselves do not respond, changing the observed evidence.

findings.evidenceJa: 臓硯はともかく、アサシンなら
findings.governingReading: Whatever may be true of Zouken, Assassin could pass the Emiya bounded field effortlessly.
findings.explanation: The English omits the explicit reservation about whether Zouken himself could do the same.

findings.evidenceJa: イリヤのいる和室へ急ぐ
findings.governingReading: Shirou hurries to the Japanese-style room where Illya is staying.
findings.explanation: The English removes the room type and spatial continuity.

findings.highlight: Even though the power failure interrupted the preparations
findings.evidenceJa: 停電で中断されたとはいえ
findings.governingReading: Although the blackout interrupted the ongoing activity, dinner is nearly due.
findings.explanation: The English supplies “the preparations” as the object of interruption.

findings.evidenceJa: 障子を開ける
findings.governingReading: Shirou opens the shoji to Illya’s room.
findings.explanation: The English removes the specific partition and room staging.

findings.evidenceJa: 無残に飛び散った血痕だけ
findings.governingReading: Only brutally splattered bloodstains are visible.
findings.explanation: The English euphemizes blood as red and removes the gruesome manner.

findings.highlight: is a bundle of silver hair
findings.evidenceJa: 銀色の糸の束が見えた気がした
findings.governingReading: Shirou feels as though he saw a bundle of silver threads in the reddened corner.
findings.explanation: The English makes both perception and identification definite.

findings.evidenceJa: もう[ruby text=イリヤ char=2]人間ではない
findings.governingReading: The surface says the remains are no longer human while the ruby reads Illya, collapsing personhood and humanity together.
findings.explanation: The English preserves only the flat statement and loses the written-reading relation.

findings.evidenceJa: あたまを急速冷凍して
findings.governingReading: Shirou metaphorically flash-freezes his nearly failing head.
findings.explanation: The English reduces the violent emergency image to calming or cooling down.

findings.highlight: I jump out into the yard
findings.evidenceJa: 最短距離である庭へ出る
findings.governingReading: Shirou exits into the garden because it is the shortest route to Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English removes the route logic.

findings.highlight: Stands something that should not exist
findings.evidenceJa: いてはならないモノがいた
findings.governingReading: Something that must not be there is standing in the garden.
findings.explanation: The English changes forbidden presence in this place into existential impossibility.

findings.highlight: Before I can answer these questions
findings.evidenceJa: その疑問を把握する前に
findings.governingReading: The attack overtakes Shirou before he can even grasp the questions.
findings.explanation: The English promotes comprehension into an attempt to answer them.

findings.highlight: there is no way to escape the dark night
findings.evidenceJa: 明かりのない夜に逃れる術など存在しない
findings.governingReading: If the entity is shadow itself, there is no means to escape it in a night without light.
findings.explanation: The English turns the lack of illumination that enables the shadow into escaping night itself.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠慮なく、めくり開けられる
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s chest is mercilessly peeled or pried open.
findings.explanation: The English preserves violence but loses the opening motion that drives the forced-bud image.

findings.evidenceJa: びゅうびゅうと花弁が舞う
findings.governingReading: The petal-like pieces whirl with repeated whooshing force.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the violent sound and motion with gentle fluttering.
